posts.author: Sky is the limit
posts.text: Dette står i FA idag; Elkem and Landsvirkjun have signed a new power purchase agreement (PPA) that secures long-term electricity supply at competitive terms and enhanced operational flexibility for Elkem's ferrosilicon plant in Iceland. Dette indikerer vel, slik jeg ser det, at denne fabrikken ikke skal selges likevel. Det var jo nevnt tidligere om mulig salg til feks et datasenter.
